customer_message: My coffee machine stopped working after three weeks. Your website says returns are limited to 14 days. Order AU-1024. I want a refund.
notes: Classic ACCC statutory guarantee case where store 14-day limit cannot exclude warranty for dead coffee machine.

customer_message: Hi, I ordered black Sony headphones on order AU-1025, but when I opened the box you delivered white ones. I want the black ones I paid for.
notes: Wrong item delivered. Business must provide prepaid return label and dispatch correct item.

customer_message: I bought the Dyson vacuum AU-1026 25 days ago. Nothing is wrong with it, but I just changed my mind and prefer a different brand. Can I return it for a refund?
notes: Change of mind submitted after 14-day store policy window. Under ACL, retailers are not required to provide change of mind refunds beyond their store policy.
